solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Strange chess-piece — rook, not knight

indicators.note: rook, not knight tells us to put the rook's letter where the knight's letter was

parts.note: the most powerful piece on a chessboard is the queen
N is the chess notation for a knight
R is the chess notation for a rook

explanation.surface: A chess player complains that a piece on the board looks odd, a rook where a knight should be.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rook, not knight' swaps the N at the end of QUEEN for R.
explanation.definitionFit: A dated synonym: something odd or peculiar was once commonly called queer.

clue.text: Important teams, we hear, as seen in Bristol and Plymouth?

definitions.text: as seen in Bristol and Plymouth?

indicators.note: we hear tells us the phrase is to be taken by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: important means key, and teams are sides, giving key sides

explanation.surface: A football commentator ranks the big teams from two West Country cities.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests football clubs from Bristol and Plymouth; in fact both are historic ports, so the definition is by example.
explanation.definitionFit: Bristol and Plymouth are both port cities, and a port is lined with wharves and harbour edges where ships tie up.

clue.text: Church supporting German city's spirit

indicators.note: in a down entry, a piece supporting another sits below it

parts.note: Essen is a city in the Ruhr in Germany
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A church bolsters a German city's morale.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the spirit of a thing is its core nature or most vital part.

clue.text: This team's manager initially not well placed after odd source of speculation

indicators.note: the following pieces are placed after the word for odd

parts.note: rum is an old British word for odd or peculiar
this team's, said by a member, is our

indicators.note: initially picks out the first letter of manager

parts.note: someone not well is ill

explanation.surface: A football club's manager is struggling, a worrying start to the season set after an odd run.
explanation.walkthrough: RUM is British slang for strange; 'placed after' sets the rest after it.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: gossip and unconfirmed stories are said to be produced by a factory of hearsay that keeps grinding them out.

clue.text: A full set's laid out without a problem

indicators.note: laid out suggests arranging items anew, so the letters of a full set's are rearranged

explanation.surface: A complete set of something, perhaps cutlery or chessmen, has been laid out with nothing missing.
explanation.walkthrough: Here the 's of set's is 'is', so its S counts as a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: perfect, flawless and impeccable all describe something free of any defect or error.

clue.text: Criminals look to hide in marshes

indicators.note: one piece goes to hide inside another, so it is placed within it

parts.note: fens are low marshy lands, especially in eastern England
lo is an old word meaning look or behold

explanation.surface: Fugitive criminals hope to lie low in the marshland.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: people who have committed serious crimes are legally termed this.

clue.text: Lumberjack's technique: crude swings, splitting a French chestnut's root

indicators.note: the jumbled letters split the other pieces apart by sitting between them

parts.note: un is the French for a

indicators.note: in a down entry the root of a word is its bottom, last letter
swings means the letters of crude move about

explanation.surface: A lumberjack swings an axe crudely at a French chestnut tree's roots.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down entry a word's 'root' is its bottom letter. 'swings' makes DERCU, and 'splitting' places it between the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A forestry term: the notch cut low on the falling side of a tree to direct where it topples.

clue.text: Bird magazine? Issue picked up

definitions.meaning: bird is British slang (from rhyming slang bird-lime) for a prison sentence
a famous American weekly news magazine

indicators.note: in a down entry, picked up means read from bottom to top

parts.note: to issue is to emit

explanation.surface: Someone asks for a bird-watching magazine, and a particular issue is collected.
explanation.walkthrough: Three routes: two definitions plus EMIT read upwards via 'picked up'. 'Bird' is British prison slang for a term served.
explanation.definitionFit: A prison sentence served is a stretch behind bars, and the famous US weekly news magazine carries the same name.

clue.text: Pigeon I trained producing undistinguished successors

indicators.note: trained suggests the letters are drilled into a new shape, so pigeon I is rearranged

explanation.surface: A racing-pigeon fancier trains a bird that produces unremarkable offspring.
explanation.definitionFit: Literary term: imitative followers or descendants of a great figure, inferior to the master, from a Greek word for those born after.

clue.text: Man brought in collection of items for Halloween costume?

indicators.note: brought in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: a set is a collection of items that belong together
he is the pronoun for a man

explanation.surface: A man is brought in with a bag of goodies for Halloween dressing-up.
explanation.definitionFit: A child dressing as a ghost traditionally drapes a white bedcloth over the head, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Gathered fool tumbled me and ran

parts.note: an ass is a fool

indicators.note: tumbled means the two letters of me fall into a new order

parts.note: colours that ran have bled

explanation.surface: A fool tumbles, gathers himself and runs off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tumbled' turns ME into EM; 'ran' is BLED in the sense of dyes spreading in the wash.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: people who have come together in one place have assembled or met.

clue.text: Increasingly accepting current style of fabric

indicators.note: accepting means taking another piece inside

parts.note: increasingly means more and more
I is the symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: A fashion is gaining ground, with current tastes increasingly embracing a certain fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: A watered silk or similar textile with a rippled, wavy sheen.

clue.text: Bloodthirsty as ray-gun in blasting?

indicators.note: blasting suggests the letters are blown apart and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone firing a science-fiction ray-gun seems eager for carnage.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: from the Latin for blood, it describes someone eager for slaughter or violence.

clue.text: Writer's work recalled by SF film

indicators.note: recalled means the word is called back, read in reverse

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
ET is Spielberg's science-fiction film about an extra-terrestrial

explanation.surface: An author's book is remembered alongside a science-fiction movie.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is 'is', linking definition to wordplay; 'recalled' reverses the short form of opus.
explanation.definitionFit: A writer of verse is a kind of writer, so this is a definition by example.

clue.text: Arabs, tense, being out of place in icy water

indicators.note: letters out of place are in the wrong order, so they need rearranging

explanation.surface: Arab travellers feel tense and out of place in a frozen sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A cold Arctic sea north of Norway and Russia, named after the Dutch explorer Willem Barentsz.

clue.text: Lovely lady (not half!) between sheets? On the contrary

indicators.note: the clue first says the lady goes between the sheets
on the contrary reverses the relationship, so the sheets go inside the lady
not half removes half the word, here its first two letters

parts.note: taken as written, the word lady
a ream is a quantity of sheets of paper

explanation.surface: A cheeky remark about an attractive woman in bed, with an exclamatory 'not half!'.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not half' drops the first two letters; 'between' read with 'On the contrary' puts the sheets inside the lady, not the lady between the sheets.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal synonym: something delightful or gorgeous may be described as dreamlike in its appeal.

clue.text: A cult is actively recruiting new crackpots

indicators.note: recruiting means taking someone in, so a piece goes inside
actively suggests the letters are busy moving, so a cult is rearranged

explanation.surface: A cult is busily signing up new members, who turn out to be cranks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'actively' scrambles A CULT IS into LUATICS, and 'recruiting' takes N inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: madmen or eccentrics with wild ideas are informally called these.

clue.text: Begged to be excused a rotten flight

indicators.note: a is to be excused, so it is dropped from the word

parts.note: begged means asked
addled eggs are rotten, and addle means rotten

explanation.surface: Someone begged to leave a dreadful flight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be excused' removes A from ASKED, leaving SKED.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal synonym: a hasty departure or running away, used as a noun as well as a verb.

clue.text: Astronomical phenomenon completely captured in paragraph provided by Times

indicators.note: captured in places one piece inside another

parts.note: all means completely, as in all gone
X is the multiplication sign, read as times

explanation.surface: A star event is fully described in a paragraph of The Times newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: The apparent shift of a star's position when viewed from different points, used to measure stellar distance.

clue.text: Description of defence, one employed by the Cosa Nostra?

definitions.meaning: a popular chess opening for Black is named after the Italian island

definitions.text: one employed by the Cosa Nostra?
definitions.meaning: the Cosa Nostra is the Mafia, which began on that island, so its members are islanders

explanation.surface: A lawyer describes the defence case of a Mafia employee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'defence' looks legal but is a chess opening.
explanation.definitionFit: A well-known chess opening bears this island name, and the Mafia originated among islanders from Palermo and its region.

clue.text: Against token measuring device

definitions.meaning: a disc used in board games or as a token
a device that tallies, such as a Geiger instrument

explanation.surface: Someone objects to a token-operated meter.
explanation.walkthrough: Three separate definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: The same word means opposed to, a game piece or disc, and an instrument that tallies or registers.

clue.text: Regret restricting key salvage operation

indicators.note: restricting means hemming in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: to rue is to regret
Esc is the escape key on a computer keyboard

explanation.surface: Remorse holds back a crucial recovery effort.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: saving people or property from danger is a recovery mission.

clue.text: Galloper almost making ton with one on board

indicators.note: on board means taken aboard, inside another piece
almost means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a ton is a hundred, a century
a means one

explanation.surface: A racehorse nearly hits a hundred with a jockey aboard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims CENTURY to CENTUR, and 'on board' puts A inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A mythical half-man, half-horse creature, which as a horse gallops.

clue.text: Very good to participate in promotion of required skills

indicators.note: to participate in means to join inside, so one piece goes within the other
in a down entry, promotion lifts the word so it reads from bottom to top

parts.note: set books or texts are required ones
rad is slang for excellent, very good

explanation.surface: A top performer joins in the promotion of essential job skills.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of required' looks like part of the definition but is wordplay; RAD is slang for excellent, and 'promotion' lifts a word upwards in a down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Crafts such as plumbing or carpentry are skilled occupations, so the plural names these skills.

clue.text: Beat reporter in penning line

indicators.note: penning means enclosing, so one piece goes inside

parts.note: a cub is a young or trainee reporter

explanation.surface: A beat reporter is writing a line of copy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Beat' looks like a journalist's patch but is the verb strike.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to strike someone with a heavy stick, to cudgel them.

clue.text: Winner having change of heart, coming to eat

indicators.note: the middle letter of the word is changed for another

parts.note: a champ is a champion, a winner

explanation.surface: A winner changes his mind and comes to dinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having change of heart' changes CHAMP's central A to O.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to munch or chew noisily is to devour food.

clue.text: Amateur sports involving an island state

indicators.note: involving means including, so one piece goes inside
sports suggests the letters play about, so amateur is rearranged

explanation.surface: Amateur sports feature an island nation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sports' makes MAURETA, and 'involving' puts the island pieces inside it before the final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A country: a variant spelling of the West African nation, Mauritania, and also an ancient North African region.

clue.text: Some water power activated by start of December

parts.note: P is the symbol for power
a device activated is switched on

indicators.note: start of picks out the first letter of December

explanation.surface: A water-powered supply is turned on at the start of December.
explanation.definitionFit: A small body of still water, like a garden lake.

clue.text: Last notes about Rome made shorter?

indicators.note: made shorter trims both words, cutting the head off one and the tail off the other, so the answer lies within them

explanation.surface: A musician closes a piece about Rome with a trimmed ending.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made shorter' cuts AB from the front of 'about' and ME from the end of 'Rome', leaving the answer sitting inside the two words.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical term: the closing section of a song or piece, the opposite of an intro.

clue.text: Boy's dismay, getting blown out by female servant

parts.note: a lad is a boy

indicators.note: blown out suggests the word is shattered and its letters scattered anew

explanation.surface: A boy is dismayed when his birthday candles get blown out by a maid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting blown out' turns DISMAY into YSMAID.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman employed as personal attendant to a lady of the house, helping her dress.

clue.text: Article in Madrid gallery — it recalled apparently irrational situations

indicators.note: in places the article inside the gallery name

parts.note: the Prado is the great art museum in Madrid
a is the indefinite article

indicators.note: recalled means called back, read in reverse

parts.note: it is a euphemism for sex

explanation.surface: An article about a Madrid gallery recalls a puzzling situation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalled' turns SEX (euphemistically 'it') into XES.
explanation.definitionFit: Statements or circumstances that seem self-contradictory yet may hold true are contradictions in appearance.

clue.text: Match about to occupy a long time

indicators.note: one piece is set to occupy the inside of another

parts.note: an age is a long time
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A sports fixture runs on for a very long time.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: two things that correspond or tally are said to concur.
